cues.zh: 先把一束玫瑰看成有分量的色块，再逐步建立光色和形体。今天用十分钟认识新工作台，也练习从剪影到花瓣的过程。
cues.en: First read a bouquet as bold masses, then build its light, color, and volume. In ten minutes, explore the new workspace and work from silhouettes toward petals.

captions.text: 先把一束玫瑰看成有分量的色块，再逐步建立光色和形体。
今天用十分钟认识新工作台，也练习从剪影到花瓣的过程。

englishCaptions.text: First read a bouquet as bold masses, then build its light, color, and volume.
In ten minutes, explore the new workspace and work from silhouettes toward petals.

cues.zh: 这里是新的绘画与图像编辑工作台，从简单形状开始一段练习。花束是生成的观察参考，接下来的笔触演示来自真实绘画引擎。
cues.en: This is the updated painting workspace. Begin a study with simple shapes. The bouquet is a generated reference; the stroke demonstrations use the real painting engine.

captions.text: 这里是新的绘画与图像编辑工作台，从简单形状开始一段练习。
花束是生成的观察参考，接下来的笔触演示来自真实绘画引擎。

englishCaptions.text: This is the updated painting workspace. Begin a study with simple shapes.
The bouquet is a generated reference; the stroke demonstrations use the real painting engine.

cues.zh: 这一片只展示浅色英文界面，让画布和正在进行的笔触留在中心。侧栏平时保持收起，需要完整设置时再打开。
cues.en: This film uses the light English interface, keeping the canvas and active marks central. Keep the sidebar tucked away until you need its full controls.

captions.text: 这一片只展示浅色英文界面，让画布和正在进行的笔触留在中心。
侧栏平时保持收起，需要完整设置时再打开。

englishCaptions.text: This film uses the light English interface, keeping the canvas and active marks central.
Keep the sidebar tucked away until you need its full controls.

cues.zh: 工具栏可以放在四边，常用工具的顺序也能按习惯重新安排。把动作放到顺手的位置，画画时就少一些来回寻找。
cues.en: Dock the toolbar on any edge and reorder familiar tools to suit your habits. Put actions within reach so painting takes less searching.

captions.text: 工具栏可以放在四边，常用工具的顺序也能按习惯重新安排。
把动作放到顺手的位置，画画时就少一些来回寻找。

englishCaptions.text: Dock the toolbar on any edge and reorder familiar tools to suit your habits.
Put actions within reach so painting takes less searching.

cues.zh: 换一个工具，画布下方的胶囊就换成它此刻最需要的快捷参数。大小和透明度就近调整，完整侧栏仍然保留。
cues.en: Switch tools and the capsule shows the quick controls that matter at that moment. Adjust size and opacity nearby while the full sidebar remains available.

captions.text: 换一个工具，画布下方的胶囊就换成它此刻最需要的快捷参数。
大小和透明度就近调整，完整侧栏仍然保留。

englishCaptions.text: Switch tools and the capsule shows the quick controls that matter at that moment.
Adjust size and opacity nearby while the full sidebar remains available.

cues.zh: 鼠标现在是一支系统笔形指针，笔尖就是画布上准确的落笔位置。缩放和旋转只是改变观看方式，不会改动作品像素。
cues.en: The system mouse pointer is now a pen, whose tip marks the drawing position. Zoom and rotation change the view without changing the artwork's pixels.

captions.text: 鼠标现在是一支系统笔形指针，笔尖就是画布上准确的落笔位置。
缩放和旋转只是改变观看方式，不会改动作品像素。

englishCaptions.text: The system mouse pointer is now a pen, whose tip marks the drawing position.
Zoom and rotation change the view without changing the artwork's pixels.

cues.zh: 启动按偏好直接进入作品首页，或者进入准备好的空白绘画画布。这里能查找和排序作品，深色主题同样可以在设置中选择。
cues.en: Start directly in the project library or on a blank canvas, following your preference. Find and sort projects here. A dark theme is also available in settings.

captions.text: 启动按偏好直接进入作品首页，或者进入准备好的空白绘画画布。
这里能查找和排序作品，深色主题同样可以在设置中选择。

englishCaptions.text: Start directly in the project library or on a blank canvas, following your preference.
Find and sort projects here. A dark theme is also available in settings.

cues.zh: 内置笔刷现在有二十四个预设，初次绘画仍从默认墨水笔开始。先试几种笔触，再把常用预设收藏起来。
cues.en: There are twenty-four built-in presets; a first painting still starts with Ink. Test a few strokes, then favorite the presets you reach for.

captions.text: 内置笔刷现在有二十四个预设，初次绘画仍从默认墨水笔开始。
先试几种笔触，再把常用预设收藏起来。

englishCaptions.text: There are twenty-four built-in presets; a first painting still starts with Ink.
Test a few strokes, then favorite the presets you reach for.

cues.zh: 中文柳叶笔是英文圈选填色工具，用闭合形状建立清楚的色块。画一圈闭合轮廓，松手填色，适合花瓣和整块剪影。
cues.en: The Chinese Liuye tool is Lasso fill in English, building color masses from closed shapes. Draw a closed outline and release to fill it—ideal for petals and silhouettes.

captions.text: 中文柳叶笔是英文圈选填色工具，用闭合形状建立清楚的色块。
画一圈闭合轮廓，松手填色，适合花瓣和整块剪影。

englishCaptions.text: The Chinese Liuye tool is Lasso fill in English, building color masses from closed shapes.
Draw a closed outline and release to fill it—ideal for petals and silhouettes.

cues.zh: 叶形笔尖跟随整段笔画的方向，转弯时宽窄和姿态也一起改变。它叫柳条笔，适合收锋和拉出叶片，别与圈选填色混淆。
cues.en: The leaf-shaped tip follows the stroke, changing its width and pose as it turns. Willow helps taper strokes and form leaves; it is separate from Lasso fill.

captions.text: 叶形笔尖跟随整段笔画的方向，转弯时宽窄和姿态也一起改变。
它叫柳条笔，适合收锋和拉出叶片，别与圈选填色混淆。

englishCaptions.text: The leaf-shaped tip follows the stroke, changing its width and pose as it turns.
Willow helps taper strokes and form leaves; it is separate from Lasso fill.

cues.zh: 同一支笔改变大小和硬度，就能从局部边缘描画转向大面积铺色。再调间距和纸纹，看看笔触怎样与画布纹理相处。
cues.en: Change size and hardness to move from local edges to broad areas of color. Then adjust spacing and paper texture to see how the marks settle.

captions.text: 同一支笔改变大小和硬度，就能从局部边缘描画转向大面积铺色。
再调间距和纸纹，看看笔触怎样与画布纹理相处。

englishCaptions.text: Change size and hardness to move from local edges to broad areas of color.
Then adjust spacing and paper texture to see how the marks settle.

cues.zh: 压感分别影响大小和透明度，响应曲线也能按你的手感重新调整。需要规则图案时打开对称，先看轴线位置再落笔。
cues.en: Pressure affects size and opacity separately, with curves adjusted to your touch. For repeating forms, enable symmetry and place the axis before painting.

captions.text: 压感分别影响大小和透明度，响应曲线也能按你的手感重新调整。
需要规则图案时打开对称，先看轴线位置再落笔。

englishCaptions.text: Pressure affects size and opacity separately, with curves adjusted to your touch.
For repeating forms, enable symmetry and place the axis before painting.

cues.zh: 涂抹把已有颜色沿短笔触推开，少量混色可以连接相邻的大色块。像素笔另有清晰的像素模式，自定义笔刷也能保存和导入。
cues.en: Short smudge strokes push existing color; gentle mixing joins neighboring masses. Pixel presets keep a distinct raster mode. Custom brushes can be saved and imported.

captions.text: 涂抹把已有颜色沿短笔触推开，少量混色可以连接相邻的大色块。
像素笔另有清晰的像素模式，自定义笔刷也能保存和导入。

englishCaptions.text: Short smudge strokes push existing color; gentle mixing joins neighboring masses.
Pixel presets keep a distinct raster mode. Custom brushes can be saved and imported.

cues.zh: 先把花束看成暗红与深绿的大块，再用色轮仔细寻找冷暖关系。把选好的颜色存进个人色卡，回到画布时少一些犹豫。
cues.en: Read the bouquet as broad dark reds and greens, then find their warm and cool shifts. Save chosen colors to a personal palette so painting stays decisive.

captions.text: 先把花束看成暗红与深绿的大块，再用色轮仔细寻找冷暖关系。
把选好的颜色存进个人色卡，回到画布时少一些犹豫。

englishCaptions.text: Read the bouquet as broad dark reds and greens, then find their warm and cool shifts.
Save chosen colors to a personal palette so painting stays decisive.

cues.zh: 取色从画布寻找已经用过的颜色，也能提取一组互相联系的主要色。色卡支持几种常见交换格式，输出前留意名称是否保留。
cues.en: Pick colors already used on the canvas, or extract a related set of dominant hues. Palettes support common exchange formats; check whether names survive export.

captions.text: 取色从画布寻找已经用过的颜色，也能提取一组互相联系的主要色。
色卡支持几种常见交换格式，输出前留意名称是否保留。

englishCaptions.text: Pick colors already used on the canvas, or extract a related set of dominant hues.
Palettes support common exchange formats; check whether names survive export.

cues.zh: 渐变从两个颜色端点开始，线性与径向能建立不同的空间方向。填充用于铺区域色，渐变反转前先看预览，再决定是否确认。
cues.en: Gradients start with two color endpoints; linear and radial shapes suggest different space. Fill lays regional color. Preview a gradient's reversal before committing.

captions.text: 渐变从两个颜色端点开始，线性与径向能建立不同的空间方向。
填充用于铺区域色，渐变反转前先看预览，再决定是否确认。

englishCaptions.text: Gradients start with two color endpoints; linear and radial shapes suggest different space.
Fill lays regional color. Preview a gradient's reversal before committing.

cues.zh: 选区先把需要修改的范围说清楚，自由套索尤其适合不规则形状。矩形和椭圆更规则，魔棒则按颜色寻找相近区域。
cues.en: A selection defines the editing area; a freehand lasso suits irregular shapes. Rectangles and ellipses are regular; the wand finds areas by color.

captions.text: 选区先把需要修改的范围说清楚，自由套索尤其适合不规则形状。
矩形和椭圆更规则，魔棒则按颜色寻找相近区域。

englishCaptions.text: A selection defines the editing area; a freehand lasso suits irregular shapes.
Rectangles and ellipses are regular; the wand finds areas by color.

cues.zh: 选区可以叠加或相减，反选和边缘调整也能把修改范围整理准确。复制和剪切把局部带到新图层，让修改更容易回头。
cues.en: Add or subtract selections, invert them, and refine edges to define the edit accurately. Copy and cut move a region into a new layer, making revisions easier.

captions.text: 选区可以叠加或相减，反选和边缘调整也能把修改范围整理准确。
复制和剪切把局部带到新图层，让修改更容易回头。

englishCaptions.text: Add or subtract selections, invert them, and refine edges to define the edit accurately.
Copy and cut move a region into a new layer, making revisions easier.

cues.zh: 像素作品可以进入索引颜色模式，把整幅作品约束在同一张色卡内。它有自己的工具限制，选择之前先想清楚作品需要什么。
cues.en: An indexed-color document keeps the whole pixel artwork within one palette. It has its own tool limits; choose it to suit the artwork.

captions.text: 像素作品可以进入索引颜色模式，把整幅作品约束在同一张色卡内。
它有自己的工具限制，选择之前先想清楚作品需要什么。

englishCaptions.text: An indexed-color document keeps the whole pixel artwork within one palette.
It has its own tool limits; choose it to suit the artwork.

cues.zh: 背景与花朵先放进不同图层，把名字写清楚，再逐步加入局部细节。拖动缩略图调整顺序，用图层组整理较复杂的作品。
cues.en: Separate the background and flowers into named layers, then gradually add local detail. Reorder thumbnails and use groups to organize a more complex piece.

captions.text: 背景与花朵先放进不同图层，把名字写清楚，再逐步加入局部细节。
拖动缩略图调整顺序，用图层组整理较复杂的作品。

englishCaptions.text: Separate the background and flowers into named layers, then gradually add local detail.
Reorder thumbnails and use groups to organize a more complex piece.

cues.zh: 图层的不透明度和八种混合模式，都能先在原画布上预览和比较。透明度锁定适合改已有色块，内容锁定则保护整层。
cues.en: Preview and compare layer opacity and eight blending modes on the original canvas. Alpha lock recolors existing shapes; content lock protects the layer.

captions.text: 图层的不透明度和八种混合模式，都能先在原画布上预览和比较。
透明度锁定适合改已有色块，内容锁定则保护整层。

englishCaptions.text: Preview and compare layer opacity and eight blending modes on the original canvas.
Alpha lock recolors existing shapes; content lock protects the layer.

cues.zh: 蒙版用黑白控制图层显示范围，让遮挡和恢复都保留原来的画面。剪贴图层把新颜色限制在底层，花瓣边缘就更容易保持。
cues.en: Masks control layer visibility in black and white, preserving the original artwork. Clipping confines new color to a base layer and helps preserve petal edges.

captions.text: 蒙版用黑白控制图层显示范围，让遮挡和恢复都保留原来的画面。
剪贴图层把新颜色限制在底层，花瓣边缘就更容易保持。

englishCaptions.text: Masks control layer visibility in black and white, preserving the original artwork.
Clipping confines new color to a base layer and helps preserve petal edges.

cues.zh: 变换先预览图层的位置和尺寸，满意以后再提交为一笔完整编辑。曲线和渐变映射也能用于调整图层，继续保留修改空间。
cues.en: Preview a layer's position and size, then commit the transform as one complete edit. Curves and gradient maps can be adjustment layers, leaving room to revise.

captions.text: 变换先预览图层的位置和尺寸，满意以后再提交为一笔完整编辑。
曲线和渐变映射也能用于调整图层，继续保留修改空间。

englishCaptions.text: Preview a layer's position and size, then commit the transform as one complete edit.
Curves and gradient maps can be adjustment layers, leaving room to revise.

cues.zh: 基础矢量能编辑节点，透视助手和漫画线都可预览。复杂层导出前，先检查哪些效果需要烘焙。
cues.en: Basic vectors offer node editing; perspective assistants and comic lines can be previewed. Before exporting complex layers, check which effects need baking.

captions.text: 基础矢量能编辑节点，透视助手和漫画线都可预览。
复杂层导出前，先检查哪些效果需要烘焙。

englishCaptions.text: Basic vectors offer node editing; perspective assistants and comic lines can be previewed.
Before exporting complex layers, check which effects need baking.

cues.zh: 逐帧动画从打开时间轴开始，原画布仍然保留你熟悉的绘画方式。先加几帧简单变化，观察轮廓怎样从上一帧走到下一帧。
cues.en: Open the timeline to begin frame animation while keeping the familiar painting canvas. Add a few simple changes and watch a form move from one frame to the next.

captions.text: 逐帧动画从打开时间轴开始，原画布仍然保留你熟悉的绘画方式。
先加几帧简单变化，观察轮廓怎样从上一帧走到下一帧。

englishCaptions.text: Open the timeline to begin frame animation while keeping the familiar painting canvas.
Add a few simple changes and watch a form move from one frame to the next.

cues.zh: 先复制一帧再画变化，适合保留已经建立好的轮廓和基础色块。洋葱皮让前后位置更容易比较，但不会成为输出画面。
cues.en: Duplicate a frame before changing it to preserve the established outline and color masses. Onion skin helps compare neighboring positions without appearing in the output.

captions.text: 先复制一帧再画变化，适合保留已经建立好的轮廓和基础色块。
洋葱皮让前后位置更容易比较，但不会成为输出画面。

englishCaptions.text: Duplicate a frame before changing it to preserve the established outline and color masses.
Onion skin helps compare neighboring positions without appearing in the output.

cues.zh: 时间轴的图层轨道对应画面结构，关键帧指出哪里出现新的内容。连续单元可以共享画面，拖动标尺就能查看更长的片段。
cues.en: Timeline layer tracks reflect the artwork's structure; keyframes mark new content. Held cells can share artwork; drag the ruler to browse a longer sequence.

captions.text: 时间轴的图层轨道对应画面结构，关键帧指出哪里出现新的内容。
连续单元可以共享画面，拖动标尺就能查看更长的片段。

englishCaptions.text: Timeline layer tracks reflect the artwork's structure; keyframes mark new content.
Held cells can share artwork; drag the ruler to browse a longer sequence.

cues.zh: 每一帧的时长决定动作节奏，先在实际播放里检查轻重和停顿。范围和播放方向可以调整，小动画也值得把节奏做清楚。
cues.en: Each frame's duration shapes the rhythm; check its emphasis and pauses in actual playback. Adjust the range and direction; even a small animation benefits from clear timing.

captions.text: 每一帧的时长决定动作节奏，先在实际播放里检查轻重和停顿。
范围和播放方向可以调整，小动画也值得把节奏做清楚。

englishCaptions.text: Each frame's duration shapes the rhythm; check its emphasis and pauses in actual playback.
Adjust the range and direction; even a small animation benefits from clear timing.

cues.zh: 完成之后导出动图或图片图集，按照展示与使用方式选择输出。动图有颜色和透明度限制，格式交换也不是所有功能都通用。
cues.en: Export a GIF or image atlas according to how the sequence will be shown and used. GIF has color and alpha limits, and interchange formats do not preserve every feature.

captions.text: 完成之后导出动图或图片图集，按照展示与使用方式选择输出。
动图有颜色和透明度限制，格式交换也不是所有功能都通用。

englishCaptions.text: Export a GIF or image atlas according to how the sequence will be shown and used.
GIF has color and alpha limits, and interchange formats do not preserve every feature.

en: A rose study in broad marks

cues.zh: 这是一段基于参考取色的加速笔触练习。图像没有导入为作品，五个阶段由原生笔刷重新铺出。
cues.en: This is an accelerated brush study, with colors sampled from the reference. The reference is not imported as artwork; native brush marks build five stages.

captions.text: 这是一段基于参考取色的加速笔触练习。
图像没有导入为作品，五个阶段由原生笔刷重新铺出。

englishCaptions.text: This is an accelerated brush study, with colors sampled from the reference.
The reference is not imported as artwork; native brush marks build five stages.

cues.zh: 第一阶段用大号油画笔建立宽阔色块。先分开背景和花束，让黑色包装承托红色花团。
cues.en: Stage one lays in broad masses with a large Oils preset. Separate bouquet and background, using black wrapping to support the red blooms.

captions.text: 第一阶段用大号油画笔建立宽阔色块。
先分开背景和花束，让黑色包装承托红色花团。

englishCaptions.text: Stage one lays in broad masses with a large Oils preset.
Separate bouquet and background, using black wrapping to support the red blooms.

cues.zh: 第二阶段重新建立主要暗部和受光面。先看大面积的明暗关系，不急着描画每一片花瓣。
cues.en: Stage two establishes the main shadows and lit planes. Read the large value relationships before describing individual petals.

captions.text: 第二阶段重新建立主要暗部和受光面。
先看大面积的明暗关系，不急着描画每一片花瓣。

englishCaptions.text: Stage two establishes the main shadows and lit planes.
Read the large value relationships before describing individual petals.

cues.zh: 观察冷红与暖红的交替，让花团形成前后层次。这段取色练习展示笔触的累积，不是原速手工录像。
cues.en: Observe alternating cool and warm reds to separate the flower masses. This sampled-color study shows marks accumulating, not real-time manual footage.

captions.text: 观察冷红与暖红的交替，让花团形成前后层次。
这段取色练习展示笔触的累积，不是原速手工录像。

englishCaptions.text: Observe alternating cool and warm reds to separate the flower masses.
This sampled-color study shows marks accumulating, not real-time manual footage.

cues.zh: 第三阶段缩小笔触，逐步找回叶片和包装的转折。油画笔与干平刷留下不同边缘，帮助区分形体。
cues.en: Stage three uses smaller marks to recover turns in foliage and wrapping. Oil and Dry brush brushes leave different edges to distinguish the forms.

captions.text: 第三阶段缩小笔触，逐步找回叶片和包装的转折。
油画笔与干平刷留下不同边缘，帮助区分形体。

englishCaptions.text: Stage three uses smaller marks to recover turns in foliage and wrapping.
Oil and Dry brush brushes leave different edges to distinguish the forms.

cues.zh: 厚涂感来自色块的安排，以及有方向的笔触。这里没有模拟三维颜料，重点是明暗和边缘的控制。
cues.en: The impasto impression comes from arranged masses and directional marks. This is not a three-dimensional paint simulation; values and edges do the work.

captions.text: 厚涂感来自色块的安排，以及有方向的笔触。
这里没有模拟三维颜料，重点是明暗和边缘的控制。

englishCaptions.text: The impasto impression comes from arranged masses and directional marks.
This is not a three-dimensional paint simulation; values and edges do the work.

cues.zh: 第四阶段继续细化花瓣，把细节留给主要花朵。暗部保持简洁，少量明确的亮面就能塑造花瓣。
cues.en: Stage four refines petals, reserving detail for the main roses. Keep shadows simple; a few clear lit planes can describe the petals.

captions.text: 第四阶段继续细化花瓣，把细节留给主要花朵。
暗部保持简洁，少量明确的亮面就能塑造花瓣。

englishCaptions.text: Stage four refines petals, reserving detail for the main roses.
Keep shadows simple; a few clear lit planes can describe the petals.

cues.zh: 先把这一阶段与前面的铺色比较，再决定细化多少。有些边缘保持模糊，画面才会留下安静的空间。
cues.en: Compare this stage with the block-in before deciding how much to resolve. Leave some edges unresolved so the painting retains quiet passages.

captions.text: 先把这一阶段与前面的铺色比较，再决定细化多少。
有些边缘保持模糊，画面才会留下安静的空间。

englishCaptions.text: Compare this stage with the block-in before deciding how much to resolve.
Leave some edges unresolved so the painting retains quiet passages.

cues.zh: 最后阶段补充浅色小花与高光，再检查整体层次。练习画布由真实笔触组成，与生成参考分开展示。
cues.en: The last stage adds pale flowers and highlights, then checks the overall hierarchy. The study canvas consists of real brush marks and is shown separately from the reference.

captions.text: 最后阶段补充浅色小花与高光，再检查整体层次。
练习画布由真实笔触组成，与生成参考分开展示。

englishCaptions.text: The last stage adds pale flowers and highlights, then checks the overall hierarchy.
The study canvas consists of real brush marks and is shown separately from the reference.

cues.zh: 下面这些都是项目真实源码摘录，用来解释画面背后的分工。用浅色编辑器式排版帮助阅读，让关键代码和职责能逐行对应。
cues.en: These are actual project-source excerpts explaining the work behind the interface. A light editor-style layout makes the key code and responsibilities easier to read.

captions.text: 下面这些都是项目真实源码摘录，用来解释画面背后的分工。
用浅色编辑器式排版帮助阅读，让关键代码和职责能逐行对应。

englishCaptions.text: These are actual project-source excerpts explaining the work behind the interface.
A light editor-style layout makes the key code and responsibilities easier to read.

cues.zh: Compose Multiplatform 是 Kotlin 声明式界面框架。状态决定界面，按钮接收输入，像素交给 Rust 引擎。
cues.en: Compose Multiplatform is a declarative UI framework for Kotlin. State defines the UI, buttons receive input, and the Rust engine handles pixels.

captions.text: Compose Multiplatform 是 Kotlin 声明式界面框架。
状态决定界面，按钮接收输入，像素交给 Rust 引擎。

englishCaptions.text: Compose Multiplatform is a declarative UI framework for Kotlin.
State defines the UI, buttons receive input, and the Rust engine handles pixels.

cues.zh: 笔形指针这一段从资源读取开始，大小来自界面的基础密度。它连接系统指针服务，画布上的作品不需要为鼠标再加一圈。
cues.en: The pen pointer loads an image resource and sizes it from the base display density. It connects to the system pointer service without adding a ring to the artwork.

captions.text: 笔形指针这一段从资源读取开始，大小来自界面的基础密度。
它连接系统指针服务，画布上的作品不需要为鼠标再加一圈。

englishCaptions.text: The pen pointer loads an image resource and sizes it from the base display density.
It connects to the system pointer service without adding a ring to the artwork.

cues.zh: 画布输入先进入协调层，笔和触摸都要遵守同一套编辑边界。输入队列是有界的，后台任务再把结果带回显示层。
cues.en: Canvas input enters the coordination layer, with pen and touch sharing editing boundaries. The input queue is bounded, and background work returns results to the display layer.

captions.text: 画布输入先进入协调层，笔和触摸都要遵守同一套编辑边界。
输入队列是有界的，后台任务再把结果带回显示层。

englishCaptions.text: Canvas input enters the coordination layer, with pen and touch sharing editing boundaries.
The input queue is bounded, and background work returns results to the display layer.

cues.zh: Rust 引擎处理笔触和像素，也负责闭合填色等实际绘画操作。这不是一段播放好的效果动画，画布结果来自真实引擎。
cues.en: The Rust engine processes strokes and pixels, including closed-shape fills. These canvas results come from the real engine, not a prerecorded effect animation.

captions.text: Rust 引擎处理笔触和像素，也负责闭合填色等实际绘画操作。
这不是一段播放好的效果动画，画布结果来自真实引擎。

englishCaptions.text: The Rust engine processes strokes and pixels, including closed-shape fills.
These canvas results come from the real engine, not a prerecorded effect animation.

cues.zh: 画布按像素块组织，发生修改的区域才需要更新到界面。未改像素共享能减少重复复制，也为每一次撤销保留原来内容。
cues.en: The canvas is organized into tiles, so changed areas can be sent to the interface. Shared unchanged pixels avoid repeated copying and retain earlier content for every undo.

captions.text: 画布按像素块组织，发生修改的区域才需要更新到界面。
未改像素共享能减少重复复制，也为每一次撤销保留原来内容。

englishCaptions.text: The canvas is organized into tiles, so changed areas can be sent to the interface.
Shared unchanged pixels avoid repeated copying and retain earlier content for every undo.

cues.zh: 历史和工程文件同样属于引擎职责，界面主要协调用户的操作。Rust 在后台处理这些工作，不能把它们都称作显卡计算。
cues.en: History and project files also belong to the engine; the UI coordinates user actions. Rust handles that work in the background; it is not all GPU computation.

captions.text: 历史和工程文件同样属于引擎职责，界面主要协调用户的操作。
Rust 在后台处理这些工作，不能把它们都称作显卡计算。

englishCaptions.text: History and project files also belong to the engine; the UI coordinates user actions.
Rust handles that work in the background; it is not all GPU computation.

cues.zh: 基础矢量和绘画助手也沿着这条路径，把参数变成可预览的结果。把状态与像素职责分清楚，修改就更容易预览和确认。
cues.en: Basic vectors and drawing assistants use the same path from parameters to previews. Separating state from pixel work makes edits easier to preview and commit.

captions.text: 基础矢量和绘画助手也沿着这条路径，把参数变成可预览的结果。
把状态与像素职责分清楚，修改就更容易预览和确认。

englishCaptions.text: Basic vectors and drawing assistants use the same path from parameters to previews.
Separating state from pixel work makes edits easier to preview and commit.

cues.zh: 桌面与移动平台都有独立构建入口。下载文件以发行页为准，设备和驱动仍需实机验证。
cues.en: Desktop and mobile platforms have dedicated build targets. Check the release page for downloads; devices and drivers still need validation.

captions.text: 桌面与移动平台都有独立构建入口。
下载文件以发行页为准，设备和驱动仍需实机验证。

englishCaptions.text: Desktop and mobile platforms have dedicated build targets.
Check the release page for downloads; devices and drivers still need validation.

cues.zh: 工程留给继续编辑，图片用于分享。分层效果和文件交换，请先检查各格式的支持范围。
cues.en: Keep a project for editing and an image for sharing. For layered effects and file exchange, check each format’s supported scope first.

captions.text: 工程留给继续编辑，图片用于分享。
分层效果和文件交换，请先检查各格式的支持范围。

englishCaptions.text: Keep a project for editing and an image for sharing.
For layered effects and file exchange, check each format’s supported scope first.

cues.zh: 代码采用 MIT 许可，字体和图标保留各自署名。参考图为生成素材。
cues.en: The code uses MIT; fonts and icons retain their respective attributions. The reference is generated artwork.

captions.text: 代码采用 MIT 许可，字体和图标保留各自署名。
参考图为生成素材。

englishCaptions.text: The code uses MIT; fonts and icons retain their respective attributions.
The reference is generated artwork.

cues.zh: 从一块颜色开始，逐步建立形体和笔触。保存工程，为明天继续修改留下空间。
cues.en: Start with a color mass and gradually build form and marks. Save the project and leave room to continue tomorrow.

captions.text: 从一块颜色开始，逐步建立形体和笔触。
保存工程，为明天继续修改留下空间。

englishCaptions.text: Start with a color mass and gradually build form and marks.
Save the project and leave room to continue tomorrow.
